faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Project Associate post at IIT Indore is 25th August 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications via email well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for IIT Indore Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Associate position at IIT Indore is email. Interested candidates need to prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate post in the current recruitment drive at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore. Candidates should refer to the official notification for detailed information on the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Associate position at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate position at IIT Indore will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month. This attractive remuneration is offered for the contractual role.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First class B.E./B.Tech with a GATE Score in CSE or a First Class M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering to be eligible for the Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Indore Project Associate Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Indore Project Associate Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate position at IIT Indore primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate position is Indore, Madhya Pradesh, which is where the Indian Institute of Technology Indore is situated. This offers a great opportunity to work in a premier institution.

faq.question: Q9. When was the official notification released for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Indore Project Associate recruitment was released on 12th August 2026. Candidates should refer to this notification for all detailed information and instructions regarding the application process.
